## PageWindowResult interface

What `execute` resolves to for a request with a [PageWindow](./core.pagewindow.md)<!-- -->, as a wire record.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface PageWindowResult
```

## Remarks

The runtime turns it into the operation's page: whether more items remain is `offset + size < length`<!-- -->, and the next page is anchored on `last`<!-- -->.
